name: Alemeth
overview: Alemeth was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Becher. His mention in Scripture is brief, with no additional notes or distinguishing events recorded. His identity is primarily established through his lineage within the tribe of Benjamin.
namesAndTitles: The name Alemeth is a proper name meaning "concealment." This meaning is derived from the Hebrew and is not indicated as being given directly by God. The name reflects a common biblical practice of meaningful personal names.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Alemeth as the son of Becher, establishing his place within the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin. No other family relationships are noted beyond this direct paternal link.
scriptureSignificance: While Alemeth is not a prominent figure in the biblical narrative, his inclusion in the genealogical record of Benjamin highlights the importance of family lines in God's covenant people. His mention underscores the faithfulness of God in preserving the tribes of Israel through successive generations.
